analysis.purpose: The grounding validator: checks that an evidence quote actually appears in the code span it cites — the single gate that separates authored knowledge from a plausible-sounding summary.
responsibilities: Rehydrate the cited span and compare the quote against it
Normalize whitespace so formatting differences do not fail a real quote
Report per-item verdicts so partial grounding is visible

businessRules.rule: An artifact whose every quote fails overlap is rejected as hallucination, not merely flagged.
businessRules.rationale: Ungrounded prose in a knowledge graph is worse than no prose at all.

nodes.name: Grounding gate
nodes.summary: Authored claims must cite real code.

edges.rationale: This file is the grounding validator.
